name: Vox Style Explainer
summary: Give it a link or some text, and it makes a Vox-style explainer video from it.

compatibility.selects: Selects 2.0.512 or later with media generation for plug-in panels. Uses askAI and runScript, and the host's FileSystem (files and downloads) and bundled ffmpeg/ffprobe; no shell, no Python. The engine runs inside the panel on macOS and Windows (a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending).
